scope: deterministic stand-in versus real model/LangGraph/production claims

limitations: idempotence is asserted from fixture side_effect=none
no retry exhaustion or conflict path

supported: no second logical draft in fixture
limitations: persisted/durable wording is not backed by storage
no concurrent ordering or late callback
dedupe behavior is local branch logic

supported: old checkpoint is retained in local state
limitations: source_result is regenerated, not recovered from durable storage
no checkpoint integrity or migration version check

supported: timeout state and stop condition are represented
limitations: no real clock, cancellation, late result, or partial output

supported: recovery occurs before draft/check/hand-off in fixture
limitations: no real queue or checkpoint store

supported_claims: The deterministic fixture can reproduce five preset paths with first-failure, stopped, recovery and no-external-action fields.
The reviewer rerun produces the same output hash as the author run.
The fixture explicitly declares no real model, no LangGraph import, disabled network, no paid API and no external writes.
The local stand-in preserves an A-tenant source field and a draft-ready-for-review hand-off on successful branches.
critical_non_claims: No real provider model output or quality evidence
No real LangGraph package/API or course-code compatibility evidence
No durable checkpoint, process crash, queue, concurrency or production recovery evidence
No proof of tenant-B rejection because no unauthorized request is executed
No general JSON Schema validation evidence
No cost, latency, user value, learner transfer or L1 capability evidence

issues.title: Tenant rejection path not exercised
issues.evidence: source_result() always returns the fixed A document; no B request or rejection receipt exists.
issues.retest: Run explicit B-document/tenant request, preserve denial code and no-downstream-generation evidence, then run A regression and an independent holdout.

issues.title: No durable checkpoint or recovery-fault evidence
issues.evidence: States are in-memory dictionaries; no durable write, process stop or actual restore occurs.
issues.retest: Use auditable local durable storage, inject write failure/process interruption, and record checkpoint/result references and replay key.

issues.title: Claim-level source and version binding is insufficient
issues.evidence: Only PLR-AI-006 and fixture-source-v2 fields are present; no source_ref, claim_type, course locator or LangGraph package version.
issues.retest: Tag each claim as course fact, official framework fact, project assumption or local observation; record section/API/package version and access date, or retain insufficient_evidence.

issues.title: Authorization tool contract is not executed
issues.evidence: The fixed source function does not accept or validate tenant/document inputs.
issues.retest: Execute authorized, unauthorized, missing-document and source-conflict paths.

issues.title: Durable-result wording overstates the stand-in
issues.evidence: Duplicate and old-checkpoint paths say persisted/durable/recovered while reconstructing fixed in-memory values.
issues.retest: Rename to synthetic state reconstruction or provide actual local durable storage evidence; do not mix the two.

issues.title: Timeout branch is symbolic rather than a timed fault
issues.evidence: The script directly appends timeout without clock, cancellation, late callback or partial-output behavior.
issues.retest: Inject a controllable clock/task interruption and preserve pre/post timeout evidence.

issues.title: Field assertions are not schema validation
issues.evidence: draft() creates a complete fixed dictionary and checks only fixed values; malformed/partial/extra-field cases are absent.
issues.retest: Add versioned schema and malformed, partial, extra-field, empty-citation and conflicting-source fixtures.

issues.title: State vocabulary remains unmapped
issues.evidence: Earlier D0 uses tool_requested/source_checked/draft_ready while v0.3 uses tool_called/tool_returned/checked/handed_off.
issues.retest: Freeze a versioned enum, transition conditions and an explicit old-to-new mapping with human approval states.

issues.title: Human intervention and holdout migration are not executed
issues.evidence: No approve/reject/escalate event and no non-author frozen transfer variant are present.
issues.retest: Run human reject/recovery and one unseen queue/checkpoint constraint under independent QA freeze.

issues.title: Retry safety is inferred from side_effect=none
issues.evidence: The empty-result retry changes idempotency key and no tool implementation demonstrates idempotent behavior or retry exhaustion.
issues.retest: Record actual idempotency contract, same/different key behavior, exhausted budget and source-conflict handling; otherwise keep retry_safety_unverified.
